item.title: chronokv-db
item.description:
chronokv-db Manual Page

NAME

chronokv-db - Distributed, Fault-Tolerant Key-Value Storage Engine built in Compound (.hg).

OVERVIEW FOR EVERYONE (NON-TECH & TECH)

Non-Technical Summary:

chronokv-db is a super-fast database written in Compound. It stores information in RAM for immediate access, and automatically saves data to hard drive files (.dat) when RAM fills up. Even if the main database server crashes, another server automatically takes over in 1-2 seconds with zero data loss.

item.title: powershell-subshell
item.description:
powershell-subshell Manual Page

NAME

powershell-subshell - First-class PowerShell cmdlet integration for Compound (.hg / .eg).

OVERVIEW FOR EVERYONE (NON-TECH & TECH)

Non-Technical Summary:

powershell-subshell allows you to directly call PowerShell cmdlets from inside your Compound code using ps_kaam (Hinglish) or ps_command (English).

Technical Architecture:

  • Transpiler Rule: Intercepts ps_kaam, ps_command, ps_shell, and ps prefixes.
  • Execution: Transpiles into safe quoted PowerShell invocation (pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command).

SYNOPSIS

Hinglish (.hg):

ps_kaam "Write-Host 'Namaste from PowerShell!'"
ps "Get-Date"

Plain English (.eg):

ps_command "Write-Host 'Hello from PowerShell!'"
ps "Get-Date"

SEE ALSO

  • chronokv-db
  • vscode-tooling

item.title: vscode-tooling
item.description:
vscode-tooling Manual Page

NAME

vscode-tooling - Official Visual Studio Code Extension and Language Tooling for Compound (.hg / .eg).

OVERVIEW FOR EVERYONE (NON-TECH & TECH)

Non-Technical Summary:

vscode-tooling makes writing Compound code easy by bringing colorful syntax highlighting, auto-indentation, and bracket completion into VS Code. It automatically recognizes both Hinglish (.hg) and English (.eg) files.

Technical Architecture:

  • TextMate Grammars: hinglish.tmLanguage.json and english.tmLanguage.json defining token scopes for keywords (rakho, keep, agar, if), strings, booleans, and shell commands ($).
  • Extension Package: Packaged as a standalone VSIX file (vscode-compound/compound-lang-1.0.0.vsix).

SYNOPSIS

# Install VSIX Extension in VS Code
code --install-extension /home/narayanas/projects/compound/vscode-compound/compound-lang-1.0.0.vsix

FEATURES

  • Auto Indentation: Automatically indents after toh, do, agar, kaam, task and un-indents after khatam, bas, done, end.
  • String Protection: Prevents syntax coloring errors inside quoted strings.
  • Subshell Highlighting: Special color highlighting for direct shell command lines ($ "docker ps").

SEE ALSO

  • chronokv-db
  • shamil-import

item.title: agar / if (Conditionals & Branching)
item.description:
MAN PAGE: Conditionals (agar / if / varna / otherwise)

SYNOPSIS

  • Hinglish (hg):

    agar condition toh
    // code
varna agar condition toh
    // code
varna
    // code
khatam

  • English (eg):

    if condition do
    // code
otherwise if condition do
    // code
otherwise
    // code
done

DESCRIPTION

Executes blocks conditionally. Blocks are closed using khatam / bas in Hinglish or done / end in English.

EXAMPLES

Hinglish:

agar umar bada hai 18 se toh
    dikhao "Adult"
varna
    dikhao "Minor"
khatam

item.title: banao / type (Data Types & Structures)
item.description:
MAN PAGE: Custom Data Structures (banao / type / object)

SYNOPSIS

  • Hinglish (hg):

    banao StructName = object
    field1: type1
    field2: type2
khatam

  • English (eg):

    type StructName = object
    field1: type1
    field2: type2
done

DESCRIPTION

Defines custom record/object structures with typed fields.

EXAMPLES

Hinglish:

banao User = object
    naam: string
    umar: int
khatam

rakho u = User(naam: "Rahul", umar: 20)
dikhao u.naam

item.title: c_ka_kaam / c_func (C Language FFI Integration)
item.description:
MAN PAGE: C Language Integration (c_ka_kaam / c_func)

SYNOPSIS

  • Hinglish (hg): c_ka_kaam fnSignature from "header.h"
  • English (eg): c_func fnSignature from "header.h"

DESCRIPTION

Directly imports and calls functions from standard C libraries (stdio.h, stdlib.h, math.h) or custom compiled C code without writing glue logic.

EXAMPLES

Hinglish:

c_ka_kaam puts(s: cstring): cint from "stdio.h"
puts("Namaste C Ecosystem!")

item.title: chuno / match / switch (Pattern Matching)
item.description:
MAN PAGE: Pattern Matching (chuno / match / switch / jab / case)

SYNOPSIS

  • Hinglish (hg):

    chuno variable toh
    jab value1 toh
        // code
    jab value2 toh
        // code
    varna toh
        // default code
khatam

  • English (eg):

    match variable do
    case value1 do
        // code
    case value2 do
        // code
    otherwise do
        // default code
done

DESCRIPTION

Multi-way branching syntax based on variable values.

EXAMPLES

Hinglish:

rakho din = 1
chuno din toh
    jab 1 toh
        dikhao "Somvaar"
    varna toh
        dikhao "Koyi aur din"
khatam

item.title: dikhao / show / print (Output Command)
item.description:
MAN PAGE: Output Command (dikhao / show / print)

SYNOPSIS

  • Hinglish (hg): dikhao expression1, expression2, ...
  • English (eg): show expression1, ... or print expression1, ...

DESCRIPTION

Prints text, numbers, or variable values to stdout with automatic formatting.

EXAMPLES

Hinglish:

dikhao "Namaste World!", 100

English:

show "Hello World!", 100
print "Welcome!"

item.title: jabtak / repeat while (Loops)
item.description:
MAN PAGE: Loops (jabtak / while / har ... mein / for each ... in)

SYNOPSIS

  • Hinglish (hg): jabtak condition toh … khatam OR har item mein list toh … khatam
  • English (eg): repeat while condition do … done OR for each item in list do … done

DESCRIPTION

Repeats code block as long as condition evaluates to true or iterates over lists.

EXAMPLES

Hinglish:

rakho i = 1
jabtak i chhota ya barabar hai 5 se toh
    dikhao i
    i += 1
khatam

item.title: kaam / task / function (Functions & Subroutines)
item.description:
MAN PAGE: Functions (kaam / task / function / wapas / give back)

SYNOPSIS

  • Hinglish (hg): kaam name(args): return_type toh … wapas result … khatam
  • English (eg): task name(args): return_type do … give back result … done

DESCRIPTION

Defines reusable subroutines with arguments and optional return values.

EXAMPLES

Hinglish:

kaam jod(a: int, b: int): int toh
    wapas a + b
khatam

English:

task add(a: int, b: int): int do
    give back a + b
done

item.title: koshish_karo / try (Error Handling)
item.description:
MAN PAGE: Error Handling (koshish_karo / try / galti_pakdo / catch / aakhir_mein / finally)

SYNOPSIS

  • Hinglish (hg):

    koshish_karo toh
    // dangerous code
galti_pakdo toh
    // handle error
aakhir_mein toh
    // cleanup code
khatam

  • English (eg):

    try do
    // dangerous code
catch do
    // handle error
finally do
    // cleanup code
done

DESCRIPTION

Handles exceptions gracefully without crashing the application.

EXAMPLES

Hinglish:

koshish_karo toh
    dikhao 10 / 0
galti_pakdo toh
    dikhao "Zero se divide nahi kar sakte!"
aakhir_mein toh
    dikhao "Hamesha chalega"
khatam

item.title: pukka / fixed (Constants)
item.description:
MAN PAGE: Constants (pukka / fixed / const)

SYNOPSIS

  • Hinglish (hg): pukka CONST_NAME = value
  • English (eg): fixed CONST_NAME = value or const CONST_NAME = value

DESCRIPTION

Declares immutable compile-time constants. Attempting to modify a constant value raises a compiler error.

EXAMPLES

Hinglish:

pukka PI = 3.14159
dikhao PI

English:

fixed PI = 3.14159
show PI

item.title: rakho / create (Variable Declaration)
item.description:
MAN PAGE: Variable Declaration (rakho / create / implicit =)

SYNOPSIS

  • Hinglish (hg): rakho variable_name = value or variable_name = value
  • English (eg): create variable_name = value, set variable_name = value or variable_name = value

DESCRIPTION

Declares or assigns a variable. Compound automatically infers the data type from the assigned value.

EXAMPLES

Hinglish:

rakho umar = 25
naam = "Rahul"

English:

create age = 25
name = "Rahul"

item.title: shamil_karo / import (Module Imports)
item.description:
MAN PAGE: Module Imports (shamil_karo / import_karo / import / use)

SYNOPSIS

  • Hinglish (hg): shamil_karo module_name or import_karo module_name
  • English (eg): import module_name or use module_name

DESCRIPTION

Imports standard Nim / C libraries (such as os, strutils, math, times, json, etc.) into your Compound workspace.

EXAMPLES

Hinglish:

shamil_karo os
shamil_karo strutils

English:

import os
use strutils
